decisions.reason: Replacing the hero image does not change the approved hero headline or explanatory copy.

The same source message independently establishes replacement of the bottom founder image, which is already fully represented by the candidate's INTRODUCE Event; the hero-image modification adds no further change.
Replacing one hero asset does not alter the landing page's content mix, specification source, or screenshot-selection rule.

The client explicitly says the design itself is good, and its approval is already represented by the candidate's same-message Event; replacing the hero image does not change the visual-style requirements.
